newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam seeks oil products in tender for 2Q.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam seeks oil products in tender for 2Q.

text.p: Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) has issued a tender to buy various oil products in a tender for April-June deliveries, an industry source said on Thursday.
The tender closes at 1600 hours (Hanoi time) on March 28 and offers will be valid until the close of business on April 5.
The tender seeks 144,000 tonnes of 83-octane gasoline with a lead content of 0.15 grammes per liter and 130,000 tonnes of 170-centistoke grade fuel oil with a 3.0-percent sulphur content.
It also seeks 147,500 tonnes of diesel and combination cargoes of diesel/jet-kerosene fuel.

In its previous tender for the first quarter, Petrolimex bought a total of 212,500 tonnes of diesel and jet-kerosene fuel from US major Exxon, European major Shell, Singapore trader Hin Leong and Japanese trader Marubeni International Petroleum.
It also bought 189,000 tonnes of fuel oil from Hin Leong, Shell and Dutch trader Vitol and 85,000 tonnes of gasoline from Mitsui, Daxin and Trafigura.
The details of the second quarter tender are as follows, in tonnes (all cargoes are on a cost-and-freight basis except those indicated with * which are on a free-on-board basis):
Gasoline 18,000 Apr 15-20 Ho Chi Minh City
Fuel oil 26,000 May 1-5 Ho Chi Minh City
